fields.name: unused_head
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in all 118 save images; the boot format routine starts writing at 0x10 (code f000:0d7a)

fields.name: signature
fields.meaning: Text WILDCARDSD927Ver. Checked at power-on; on mismatch the whole save memory is formatted (files and snapshot marked empty, album cleared)
fields.evidence: code f000:0d7a checks it via f000:0e66 (boot reads at PC f000:0e72); present in every image after first boot

fields.name: last_file
fields.meaning: Number of the file saved last (0 = file 1, 1 = file 2, 2 = file 3); read at power-on to preselect the file
fields.evidence: code f000:0889 stores the slot here on every file save, f000:0d7a loads it into RAM 06de at boot (boot read PC f000:0de0); a save to file 1 shows 0, a later save to file 2 shows 1

fields.name: unused_sig_pad
fields.meaning: Zero padding written together with the signature
fields.evidence: code f000:0d7a copies a 0x30-byte ROM block (signature, zeros, date)

fields.name: build_date
fields.meaning: Text 00/12/1916:14:36 (program build stamp), written with the signature; not checked
fields.evidence: code f000:0d7a (same 0x30-byte ROM copy); identical ROM bytes found in the fixed bank

fields.name: unused_hdr
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in all 118 save images

fields.name: file1_tag
fields.meaning: THISAREAISUSED!! when the file holds a game, THISAREAISEMPTY! when empty. File 2 at 0x0E50 and file 3 at 0x1C50 share the layout (each file 0xE00 bytes)
fields.evidence: code f000:08fe writes USED on save, f000:0d7a writes EMPTY on format, f000:095a tests USED as part of loading; diffs: fresh boot EMPTY, file 1 USED after saving, file 2 USED after a save to file 2

fields.name: file1_progress_block
fields.meaning: Game progress variables (copy of RAM c400-c4ff): the name, level and deck size shown for the file on the file list derive from here, but individual bytes are unidentified; bytes at offsets 0x10-0x3D (stride 5) and 0x61-0x76 fill in as play progresses
fields.evidence: code f000:0889 table entry 0 (ROM f000:f1ef); RAM c400 is the script-variable array (script opcodes 0x30/0x31 read/write it, code f000:2f09); diffs between the new-game save and a late snapshot

fields.name: file1_packed_ca00
fields.meaning: Game state block from RAM ca00-cdff, stored two values per byte (each RAM byte keeps only its low 4 bits); only 3 of 512 values nonzero and unchanging in all saves
fields.evidence: code f000:0889 table entry 1; content diffs

fields.name: file1_packed_records
fields.meaning: Twenty 0x80-byte records (RAM d300-e6ff, 0x100 values each, stored two values per byte); probably one stats record per character or card, fixed for a playthrough
fields.evidence: code f000:0889 table entry 2; every unpacked record holds values 1..5 at offsets 0xD0-0xD8 and a 1 at 0x8A, and all 20 records are byte-identical between the new-game save and a much later snapshot, so they are set at new game (likely from the opening personality quiz)

fields.name: file1_album_flags
fields.meaning: 1024 seen-flags for this file (RAM e700-e77f), highest bit first: bit n is byte n/8, mask 0x80>>(n%8). Setting a flag also sets the same bit in the shared album at 0x7F60
fields.evidence: code f000:2c41 and script opcode 0x53 set the RAM bit and the SRAM album bit together; diffs: file flags trail the shared album by bits set after the file was written

fields.name: file1_party_ids
fields.meaning: Five member slots (RAM e780-e784); 0xFF = empty. A fresh file holds one member (02 FF FF FF FF)
fields.evidence: code f000:155c builds one 16-byte screen object per non-empty slot, f000:11d6 and f000:210f scan the list; f000:0889 table entry 4

fields.name: file1_second_list
fields.meaning: Second five-entry list (RAM e785-e789); 0xFF = empty
fields.evidence: code f000:2070 clears it to 0xFF, f000:2129 searches it for an id; same 10-byte copy as the member list (f000:0889 table entry 4)

fields.name: file1_start_table
fields.meaning: Ten bytes (RAM e78a-e793) loaded from a ROM table when a new game starts; here 05 11 12 16 00 00 00 00 00 00
fields.evidence: code f000:152a copies the row picked by ROM word f000:f370 from ROM bank 0xF9; the exact row bytes were found in the ROM file

fields.name: file1_play_time
fields.meaning: Play time: frames (0-74), seconds, minutes, hours; stops at 99:59:59. Shown on the file list (00:00:42 here)
fields.evidence: code f000:1e38 (75 Hz timer handler rolls frames at 75, stops at 99:59:59:74), f000:1487 zeroes it at new game; a later save shows more seconds

fields.name: file1_var_0674
fields.meaning: Value from RAM 0674 (here 0x0184): set from ROM at new game, changed by a scene-table routine; 0xFFFF makes a scene/sound routine take its alternate path
fields.evidence: code f000:1f53 (new-game init from ROM f000:f378), f000:16d2 (writer), f000:056e (reader)

fields.name: file1_var_06fc
fields.meaning: Four bytes from RAM 06fc-06ff (here 13 00 00 00); the last three are cleared at new game
fields.evidence: code f000:1f53 clears 06fd-06ff; f000:0889 table entry 7

fields.name: file1_unused
fields.meaning: Not written by the save routine; stays zero (still inside the checksummed range)
fields.evidence: code f000:0889 table ends at file offset 0xDAE; zero in saves

fields.name: file1_unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not written, not checksummed; stays zero
fields.evidence: code f000:0911 sums 0x6F8 words (+0x000..+0xDEF) and stores the check at +0xDF8

fields.name: file1_check_magic
fields.meaning: Text CS marking a valid checksum
fields.evidence: code f000:0911 (write), f000:095a (check, boot read PCs f000:0984/098e)

fields.name: file1_checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 0x6F8 little-endian 16-bit words at file offset +0x000..+0xDEF (tag included), kept as a 48-bit number: low word, carry word, carry-of-carry word
fields.evidence: code f000:0911 / f000:095a (boot read PC f000:0971 sums all three files); recomputed over 118 save images: every file marked USED verifies, none marked EMPTY does

fields.name: file2
fields.meaning: File 2, same layout as file 1 (base 0x0E50)
fields.evidence: code f000:0889 (base = 0x50 + file*0xE00); a save to file 2 differs from the file 1 save only in play time and checksum

fields.name: file3
fields.meaning: File 3, same layout as file 1 (base 0x1C50); empty in all saves
fields.evidence: code f000:0889, f000:0d7a; tag diffs

fields.name: suspend_tag
fields.meaning: Snapshot status: THISAREAISUSED!! = a suspended game exists (title menu shows Continue), THISAREAISEMPTY! = none. Written USED when the in-play menu opens; set back to EMPTY on resume and after Continue loads it; choosing Suspend keeps it
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 writes USED with the snapshot, f000:0de4 writes EMPTY (menu code, script opcode 0xa2); diffs: menu states USED, resume states flip only these bytes, Continue consumes it

fields.name: suspend_0600
fields.meaning: Snapshot of game variables (RAM 0600-07ff), including play time at SRAM 0x2AD0 and the snapshot request byte at 0x2B58
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 0 (ROM f000:f183), restored by f000:0b48; diffs across snapshots

fields.name: suspend_0980
fields.meaning: Snapshot of game variables (RAM 0980-0993)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 1, restored by f000:0b48; diffs

fields.name: suspend_0800
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the screen object table (RAM 0800-08ff, 16 objects of 16 bytes)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 2, restored by f000:0b48; objects are built from the member list by f000:155c

fields.name: suspend_0a00
fields.meaning: Snapshot of effect/actor slots (RAM 0a00-0a7f, 8 records of 16 bytes)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 3, restored by f000:0b48; diffs

fields.name: suspend_c000
fields.meaning: Snapshot of work area (RAM c000-c3ff)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 4, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_c400
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the game progress block (RAM c400-c4ff; same data as file offset 0x010)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 5, restored by f000:0b48; diffs

fields.name: suspend_c500
fields.meaning: Snapshot of battle/script work area (RAM c500-c5ff)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 6, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_c600
fields.meaning: Snapshot of work area (RAM c600-c9ff)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 7, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_ca00
fields.meaning: Snapshot of game state block (RAM ca00-cdff; same data as file offset 0x110)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 8, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_ce00
fields.meaning: Snapshot of work area (RAM ce00-d2ff)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 9, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_d300
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the twenty stats records (RAM d300-e6ff; same data as file offset 0x310)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 10, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_e700
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the seen-flags of the current game (RAM e700-e77f; same as file offset 0xD10)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 11, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_e780
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the two five-entry lists (RAM e780-e789; same as file offset 0xD90)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 12, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_e78a
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the start table (RAM e78a-e793; same as file offset 0xD9A)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 13, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_4600
fields.meaning: Snapshot of graphics tiles in video memory (RAM 4600-79ff) as shown at the moment of suspending
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 14, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_ea00
fields.meaning: Snapshot of work area (RAM ea00-edff)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 15, restored by f000:0b48

fields.name: suspend_fc00
fields.meaning: Snapshot of the colour palette work copy (RAM fc00-fdff, 12-bit colours)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table entry 16, restored by f000:0b48; contents look like palette data

fields.name: suspend_play_time
fields.meaning: Play time inside the snapshot (RAM 0670): frames, seconds, minutes, hours; a later snapshot shows a later time
fields.evidence: code f000:1e38 (same counter as the file play time); snapshot diffs

fields.name: suspend_request
fields.meaning: Snapshot control bytes (RAM 06f8-06f9): 06f8 bit 0 requests a snapshot, bit 7 requests a load; 06f9 reports the result
fields.evidence: code f000:3df9 tests and clears 06f8 every frame, f000:1f53 clears both at new game; a kept snapshot shows 01 01

fields.name: suspend_unused
fields.meaning: Not written by the snapshot; zero (inside the checksummed range)
fields.evidence: code f000:09c2 table ends at 0x7F08

fields.name: suspend_unused_tail
fields.meaning: Not written, not checksummed; zero
fields.evidence: code f000:0a37 sums 0x2A78 words (0x2A50-0x7F3F)

fields.name: suspend_check_magic
fields.meaning: Text CS marking a valid snapshot checksum
fields.evidence: code f000:0a37 (write), f000:0af5 (check, boot read PC f000:0b20)

fields.name: suspend_checksum
fields.meaning: Sum of the 0x2A78 little-endian 16-bit words at 0x2A50-0x7F3F (tag included) as a 48-bit number: low word, carry word, carry-of-carry word. Continue is offered only when this matches
fields.evidence: code f000:0a37 / f000:0af5 (boot read PC f000:0b0f); recomputed over 118 save images: every snapshot marked USED verifies

fields.name: album_tag
fields.meaning: Text INITIALIZEDforGC; if missing, the album below is cleared and the tag rewritten
fields.evidence: code f000:0e04 (check), f000:0e27 (clear + write)

fields.name: album_flags
fields.meaning: Shared album: 1024 seen-flags kept for all files (highest bit first, same numbering as the per-file flags). Not covered by any checksum
fields.evidence: code f000:2c41 and opcode 0x53 (set), f000:6c95 and opcode 0xac (test); bits are set while watching the opening and starting play

fields.name: unused_chk
fields.meaning: Reserved for a memory self-test (text INITforCHK) that is switched off in this release; stays zero
fields.evidence: code f000:0cc4 returns at once because ROM byte f000:ffe0 = 01; zero in all saves

fields.name: unused_end
fields.meaning: Not used; stays zero
fields.evidence: zero in all saves

fields.name: internal_eeprom
fields.meaning: Not used by this game (console data only; unchanged in every save)
fields.evidence: byte-identical in all 118 save pairs
